text: Forged-cookie test cannot fail on the signature check: its cookie 'id.9999999999.deadbeef' has 3 parts and is dropped by the !mac guard before the MAC compare. Mutation: delete the timingSafeEqual line in src/http/auth.ts (~L86) -> all 74 api tests pass and a forged admin cookie 'id.9999999999.1.AAAA' gets 200 on /api/me (HEAD: 401). Add a 4-part cookie with a wrong MAC.
